title: FIFA Found Congo Player Ineligible but Let Him Play in World Cup
summary_full: Officials determined that a goalkeeper from the Democratic Republic of Congo did not have the correct paperwork, documents show. But no action was taken, renewing questions about FIFA’s governance.
